items.summary: Implement backend data models and stable storage for Polls, including: a poll question, a list of 2+ option labels, per-option vote counts, createdAt timestamp, and creator principal. Each authenticated principal can cast at most one vote per poll (changing vote should be supported by replacing their previous vote).

Add backend canister APIs for polls: createPoll(question, options) -> pollId (or poll object), getPoll(pollId), getAllPolls (newest first), and votePoll(pollId, optionIndex). Ensure APIs follow the existing single-actor access-control pattern (only signed-in users can create/vote; all users can read).

Add/extend backend upgrade migration so existing canister state upgrades safely when introducing poll storage (initialize an empty poll store and any per-user vote index needed) without losing existing media/live/comment/profile data.
Add React Query hooks for polls: fetch all polls, fetch a single poll, create a poll, and vote on a poll. Ensure caches update immediately after create/vote (invalidate/refetch the relevant queries).

Add a new Polls page to the app with: (1) a list of existing polls (newest first), (2) a poll creation form for signed-in users (question + 2+ options with add/remove option controls), and (3) a poll voting UI where users can select an option and immediately see percentage results per option. Guests can browse polls but must sign in to create/vote (show an English prompt).
